stalls.where: 饒河街 160 號前（127 號攤）
stalls.summaryZh: 十多種藥材燉的湯頭溫潤微甜、藥味不重，怕中藥味的人也能接受；排骨軟嫩，羊肉不腥，順手加一碗滷肉飯。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: A broth of more than a dozen herbs that is mellow, slightly sweet and not medicinal, so even people who dislike herbal flavours can enjoy it. The ribs are tender and the lamb has no gamey taste. Add a bowl of braised pork rice. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.where: 八德路四段 759 號（慈祐宮側入口附近）
stalls.summaryZh: 冷滷味調味清淡、帶淡淡沙茶香，鹹中有甜；鴨翅、脆腸是熱門品項，晚來容易賣完。週一公休，米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Cold braised snacks with a light seasoning and a hint of satay, salty with a touch of sweetness. Duck wings and crispy intestine are the favourites and sell out if you come late. Closed Mondays. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.where: 饒河街 249 號前（慈祐宮旁夜市入口）
stalls.summaryZh: 手工現包、貼在炭窯烤，外皮酥香帶芝麻，咬開肉汁多、胡椒微辣；一開攤就排隊，剛出爐很燙要小心。米其林必比登推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Hand-made and baked against the wall of a charcoal kiln. The crust is crisp with sesame, and the pork filling is juicy with a mild pepper kick. A line forms as soon as it opens. Fresh buns are very hot. Michelin Bib Gourmand.

stalls.summaryZh: 1937 年創立的老店，麵線湯不勾芡、口味清爽，油飯有麻油和薑香、粒粒分明，可加自製辣醬。
stalls.summaryEn: Founded in 1937. The vermicelli comes in a clear, unthickened broth. The oily rice has sesame-oil and ginger notes with separate grains. House chili sauce is available.

sources.title: 饒河夜市必吃15攤（食尚玩家，2026）
饒河夜市美食推薦（美麗佳人，2025）

stalls.summaryZh: 手工麻糬軟到幾乎入口即化、不黏牙，花生粉、芝麻糖另外包可自己調甜度；常賣完，週一、二公休。多年獲米其林推薦。
stalls.summaryEn: Handmade mochi so soft it almost melts and does not stick to your teeth. Peanut powder and sesame sugar come separately so you control the sweetness. Often sells out. Closed Mondays and Tuesdays. Recommended by Michelin for several years.

sources.title: 饒河夜市必吃15攤（食尚玩家，2026）
饒河夜市美食推薦（美麗佳人，2025）

stalls.summaryZh: 日籍老闆創立的圓形大阪燒，餡料有高麗菜、蝦、培根等，外層焦香、內餡飽滿，刷醬加美乃滋和柴魚片。
stalls.summaryEn: A round okonomiyaki-style pancake started by a Japanese owner, filled with cabbage, shrimp, bacon and more. Crisp outside and full inside, finished with sauce, mayo and bonito flakes.

sources.title: 饒河夜市必吃15攤（食尚玩家，2026）
饒河夜市美食推薦（美麗佳人，2025）

stalls.summaryZh: 不是烤魷魚而是現燙魷魚，口感脆Q，淋沙茶醬配蒜頭九層塔，可調辣度或加醬油芥末。
stalls.summaryEn: Not grilled but freshly blanched squid with a crisp, chewy bite, dressed with satay sauce, garlic and basil. Adjust the spice level or add soy sauce and wasabi.

sources.title: 饒河夜市必吃15攤（食尚玩家，2026）
饒河夜市美食推薦（美麗佳人，2025）

stalls.summaryZh: 外層糖衣脆、裡面鬆軟綿密，不黏牙也不黏手，甜而不膩，有人說吃起來像糖葫蘆版地瓜。
stalls.summaryEn: A crisp sugar shell over soft, fluffy sweet potato that does not stick to teeth or fingers. Sweet but not cloying. Some compare it to a candied-hawthorn version of sweet potato.

sources.title: 饒河夜市必吃15攤（食尚玩家，2026）
饒河夜市美食推薦（美麗佳人，2025）

stalls.summaryZh: 手工銅鑼燒餅皮鬆軟、甜度溫和，有紅豆、抹茶、提拉米蘇等多種口味，迷你尺寸方便一次吃好幾種。週三公休。
stalls.summaryEn: Handmade dorayaki with fluffy pancakes and mild sweetness, in flavours such as red bean, matcha and tiramisu. Mini sizes let you try several. Closed Wednesdays.
